Playmaker Sports Foundation Announces Student-Athlete Scholarship at the 2026 Playmakers Cup

Helping young athletes stay in the game: one eligible player will receive up to $500 toward club soccer fees or equipment. Applications close November 20.

By Playmaker Sports Foundation

Helping young athletes stay in the game.

The Playmaker Sports Foundation is proud to announce its first-ever Student-Athlete Scholarship, an initiative designed to help young soccer players overcome financial barriers and continue pursuing their passion for the game.

One eligible player participating in the 2026 Playmakers Cup will receive up to $500 toward documented club soccer fees or soccer equipment. The scholarship will be presented on November 29, 2026, during the Playmakers Cup in Moorpark, California.

It is an important milestone for the Foundation as it begins expanding opportunities for young athletes and helping families manage the cost of youth sports.

Making Soccer More Accessible

We believe every young athlete deserves the opportunity to develop, compete, and grow through sports, and that financial challenges should not keep players out of the game they love. Through this scholarship, we aim to give meaningful support to a player and their family and make continued participation more accessible.

The Playmakers Cup is organized by Playmaker Sports. The scholarship is an initiative of the separate Playmaker Sports Foundation, reflecting its commitment to expanding access to youth sports.

Scholarship Details

  • Award: Up to $500
  • Recipients: One player
  • Eligibility: Students in grades 6–12 registered and participating with a team in the 2026 Playmakers Cup
  • Application deadline: November 20, 2026, at 11:59 p.m. Pacific
  • Recipient notification: By November 28, 2026
  • Award presentation: November 29, 2026, at the Playmakers Cup in Moorpark, California

The recipient will be selected based on demonstrated financial need and the information provided in their application. The award reimburses eligible, documented club soccer fees or soccer equipment, up to $500. Applicants do not need to submit tax returns or bank statements, and a parent or legal guardian must review and acknowledge applications for players under 18.

Apply for the Scholarship

Eligible players and families are encouraged to apply before the November 20 deadline.

Learn More & Apply Now

For questions or assistance, contact info@playmakersportsfoundation.org.

Looking Ahead

This scholarship is the first step in the Foundation's ongoing efforts to create more opportunities for young athletes. Through future scholarships, clinics, and other community initiatives, the Foundation aims to help more players access the benefits of sports, regardless of their financial circumstances.

We look forward to recognizing our inaugural recipient at the 2026 Playmakers Cup and continuing to build opportunities for the next generation of athletes.

— Playmaker Sports Foundation
